title: Research on High Frequency Trading Strategy of Financial Market Based on Scorecard and Machine Learning Model
content: Based on scorecard and machine learning model, this paper proposes an innovative solution to the volatility prediction problem in high-frequency trading in financial markets. As an important index reflecting the short-term volatility of asset prices, volatility not only provides the basis for investors to evaluate market risks and formulate strategies, but also directly affects the decision-making efficiency in high-frequency trading. High dimensional sparsity, nonlinearity, high noise and non-stationary characteristics of high-frequency trading data make it difficult for traditional models to deal with complex market environment effectively, resulting in poor prediction accuracy and practical application effect. In order to solve this problem, this paper studies and innovates from the following three aspects. In this paper, a factor feature selection method based on reinforcement learning and bee colony optimization is proposed to effectively deal with the high dimensionality of high-frequency trading data and the complex correlation between features. Through distributed search and adaptive optimization, this method can screen out representative features more accurately and improve model efficiency. A volatility prediction model combining noise reduction autoencoder and unstable attention mechanism is designed. The model eliminates noise interference in data by noise reduction autoencoder, enhances the clarity of data, and captures non-stationary features in time series by unstable attention mechanism, which greatly improves the performance of the model in volatility prediction. This paper constructs a financial high-frequency trading volatility prediction system based on Django framework, and applies the theoretical model to practice to provide investors with real-time volatility analysis and trading strategy optimization tools, which significantly improves the efficiency and accuracy of decision support. This paper not only puts forward a powerful solution to the complexity processing of high-frequency trading data in theory, but also makes the research results have high application value through system development. This research provides a new technical path for financial high-frequency trading strategies, and further promotes the application and development of big data and artificial intelligence technology in financial markets.
